lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

The trade war between Canada and the U.S. is putting a strain on businesses in Alaska, a state that could elect a Democratic senator for the first time in nearly two decades, The Canadian Press reports.
Chuck Schumer, Hakeem Jeffries, and top Democrats unleashed fury at Haley Stevens after her endorsement of Republican Mike Rogers before Tuesday, Fox News reports.
The Justice Department may still have an opportunity to pursue a grand jury indictment against the ex-FBI officials, The Associated Press reports.

President Donald Trump’s administration appealed to the Supreme Court on Monday in its push to sideline thousands of disputed California mail ballots the day before the pivotal, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
